validation.scope: Observed evidence from a separately approved laboratory; not deployment approval or readiness for a new deployment.
validation.pythonTestScope: Inert supervisor, fake Windows/WHP APIs, restricted management configuration and answer-template regression tests; no guest execution or real hypervisor query.

whpCapabilityReadOnlyProbe.scope: A separate read-only query on the laboratory host; no partition creation or host configuration changes. Availability must be checked for every WHPX launch.

validation.whpxGuestBootScope: The guest reached the desktop and role/service marker. Later Microsoft RDP reference logons were observed separately. A WHPX guest reset panicked; clean power-off and a new launch subsequently worked. Workload and physical-seat support remain unverified.

stoppedGuestCheckpoint.scope: Private checkpoint verified after clean TCG shutdown and before the WHPX boot; no host configuration changes.

validation.nativeCheckScope: Newly created sleeping Python helpers: job termination and kill on job closure.

guestBootstrapObservation.scope: Historical bootstrap marker before the separate RDP reference and provider activation experiments; not current provider registration state.

validation.guestDiskReadOnlyCheck: Read-only qcow2 checks found no structural errors. They do not establish a clean shutdown, successful setup or guest filesystem integrity.

guestSetupFailure.verificationScope: Corrected installation reached the desktop and the role/service marker. Later RDP reference and custom-provider activation observations are recorded separately.
guestSetupFailure.nextStep: Preserve the verified service/listener activation and cleanup evidence, then implement a bounded authenticated connection trigger.

referenceObservation.scope: Microsoft's existing Server RDP path, separate from the RETSAR provider and physical-seat milestone.

providerActivationObservation.scope: Disposable Server guest only; activation diagnostics remain distinct from native session creation.

attempts.startup: clean guest power-off and fresh launch

attempts.configuration: own enabled listener with explicit DLL NetworkService read/execute

providerActivationObservation.listenerFlagScope: Inferred from Microsoft's RDP-Tcp prerequisite; not a guarantee for a custom protocol. No other listener defaults or security policies copied.
providerActivationObservation.nextStep: Implement a bounded authenticated trigger reaching the service-created listener; connection and licensing contracts remain unimplemented.

thirdAttempt.dllDaclBefore: Full control for SYSTEM, Administrators and local Administrator; no NetworkService grant.
thirdAttempt.dllDaclAfter: Protected DACL: SYSTEM and Administrators full control; NetworkService read/execute.

helperValidation.scope: Inert logic, in-memory security descriptors, layout and synthetic buffers; no file ACL changes, WTS, ETW control, registry, service or guest operations.

validation.guestSessionCreationScope: This flag refers to a RETSAR-created owned session; the separately observed Microsoft RDP reference does not satisfy it.
validation.developmentStorageScope: Current source, builds and heavy laboratory assets are on D:. No concrete private host paths are published.

purpose: Validate the C++ RDS provider against a real Windows Server guest.
doesNotProve: independent ownership of host monitors or input devices
hardware graphics acceleration or application compatibility

requiredFor: official evaluation media and its applicable license terms

guest.deploymentStateScope: Unprovisioned defaults for a new deployment; observed laboratory results are recorded under validation.
guest.activationAndUpdateNetworkPlan: pending; baseline has no guest outbound access

whpxPreflight.failureBehavior: Stop before child creation; do not enable features, change services or fall back.

behavior: Check free space on C: and the selected C: or D: laboratory volume before launch and while supervising the guest.
Stop the owned guest if either distinct monitored volume reaches the threshold.
Terminate only the supervisor's owned job on threshold, monitor failure or controller EOF.
Keep the unnamed kill-on-close job handle non-inheritable.
Create the child suspended, assign its handle to the job, then resume it.
limitations: Provisioning, media downloads and disk copies require separate preflight checks.
Other applications, delayed polling and buffered writes can cross the desired floor.
The guest-disk throttle does not cap every host write.
Forced termination can leave the disposable guest disk unclean.

machineProposal.cpuModelScope: TCG only; the WHPX branch omits -cpu for the verified QEMU build.
machineProposal.firmware: UEFI; compatible firmware files must be verified before provisioning
machineProposal.storageInterface: emulated NVMe; corrected installed-system desktop and bootstrap entry observed; workload compatibility remains unverified
machineProposal.graphics: emulated standard VGA; no host GPU passthrough
machineProposal.pointer: emulated USB tablet; no host device passthrough

controller.transport: QMP over private child stdin and stdout pipes

unattendedSetup.executionEvidenceScope: Historical setup/bootstrap observation: corrected desktop and role/service marker, with providerRegistered=false and createdSeat=false at that stage. Later reference and provider experiments are recorded separately under validation.

perDeploymentPrerequisites: Obtain explicit resource and applicable license approval.
Obtain and verify official media; prepare only a disposable guest disk.
Verify QEMU dependencies, firmware, private paths and loopback ports.
If explicitly choosing WHPX, verify existing capability read-only and exact-build guest compatibility; do not enable host hypervisor features.
Review private answer-media credentials and the fixed guest-disk-only wipe scope.
Keep the supervisor controller input open throughout the run.
Agree activation and updates networking separately from the restricted baseline.
Verify guest boot, role configuration and real session creation as separate acceptance stages for each deployment.
